title
This is the Moss Piglet Play Pen: an open workbench for building the tardigrade connectome, the same way the fly connectome was built.
home
The home page lays out the whole recipe, from imaging, to segmentation, to naming every neuron.
progress
Progress shows exactly what's done, and what's still needed.
datasets
Tardigrade data isn't public yet, so we load real stand-ins.
celegans
Here's the real C. elegans connectome: four hundred forty-eight cells, and more than seven thousand connections, all searchable.
graph
Every step lives in a knowledge graph, marked built or needed, each with its own address.
chat
Ask the chat what's next. No API key needed. It answers straight from the graph.
worklog
The worklog keeps timestamped proof of every task.
install
And any agent can plug in, through a command line tool, Python, R, or an MCP server.
end
It's open source, and built so anyone can step in and help finish it. Try it at moss piglets play pen dot vercel dot app.
